content.doc_md:
When you do not want others (or yourself) to change existing variable values, use theconstkeyword (this will declare the 
variable as "constant", which meansunchangeable and read-only):

You should always declare the variable as constant when you have values that are unlikely to change:

When you declare a constant variable, it must be assigned with a value:

### Code Snippets

```
const
int myNum = 15;  // myNum will always be 15
myNum = 10;  // error: 
  assignment of read-only variable 'myNum'

---

const
int minutesPerHour = 60;

---

const int minutesPerHour = 60;

---

const int minutesPerHour;
minutesPerHour = 60; // error
```
